security_audit.summary: The static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown command examples, inline code, normal dependency links, and ordinary launch-planning prose. The skill does use documented `belt` CLI workflows for image generation and research, but I found no hidden execution, obfuscation, credential theft, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent.

remediation.issue: External CLI examples may send prompts or search queries to third-party services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short privacy note telling users to avoid sensitive product data when running `belt app run` examples.

remediation.issue: Inline install commands can be mistaken for commands the skill runs automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Label installation commands as manual setup steps and advise users to review package sources before installing.

content.value_statement: Product Hunt launches require clear positioning, strong visuals, and fast launch-day response. This skill turns those moving parts into a practical plan for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users.
actual_capabilities: Explains Product Hunt listing limits for taglines, descriptions, topics, makers, links, and gallery assets.
Recommends gallery image order, image dimensions, and content goals for each launch asset.
Provides tagline formulas and examples for concise Product Hunt positioning.
Defines launch timing guidance, including recommended days and a midnight Pacific launch window.
Supplies a maker comment structure and launch-day engagement schedule.
Includes example `belt` commands for image generation and launch research workflows.
limitations: It does not submit a Product Hunt listing or manage the launch account.
It cannot guarantee ranking, upvotes, traffic, or Product Hunt editorial placement.
Its example research commands depend on external `belt` apps and service availability.
Product Hunt rules and interface details can change, so users should verify current requirements.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Startup Launch
use_cases.description: Create a checklist for listing copy, gallery assets, maker comments, and launch-day response before a startup launch.

use_cases.title: Improve Launch Positioning
use_cases.description: Refine taglines, descriptions, and gallery sequencing so visitors understand the product value quickly.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Launch Day
use_cases.description: Plan launch timing, comment response windows, social posts, and post-launch follow-up tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Launch Checklist
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a first Product Hunt launch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the product-hunt-launch skill to create a Product Hunt launch checklist for my product. Product: [name]. Audience: [audience]. Main value: [value]. Launch target date: [date].

prompt_templates.title: Draft Listing Copy
prompt_templates.scenario: Writing a Product Hunt tagline, description, and maker comment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the product-hunt-launch skill to draft Product Hunt listing copy. Include five tagline options under 60 characters, a concise description, and a maker comment. Product details: [details].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Gallery Assets
prompt_templates.scenario: Designing the launch gallery sequence before visual production.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the product-hunt-launch skill to plan five Product Hunt gallery images. For each image, specify the goal, visual concept, key message, and what product evidence should appear.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Launch Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced launch preparation across research, assets, timing, and engagement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the product-hunt-launch skill to build a complete Product Hunt launch strategy. Include competitor research questions, gallery strategy, listing copy, launch-day timeline, engagement rules, and post-launch follow-up.

output_examples.input: A founder asks for a launch-day plan for an analytics tool.
output_examples.output: A timed Product Hunt schedule with launch setup, maker comment posting, social sharing windows, comment response periods, and end-of-day follow-up.

output_examples.input: A marketer asks how to improve gallery assets before launch.
output_examples.output: A five-image gallery sequence covering hero value, feature demonstration, before-and-after outcome, proof points, and technical differentiators.

output_examples.input: An indie maker asks for tagline ideas for a developer tool.
output_examples.output: Several concise tagline options with notes on clarity, audience fit, benefit strength, and Product Hunt character limits.

best_practices: Validate the tagline with people who do not already know the product.
Show real product screens and outcomes in the first gallery image.
Prepare maker comments, social posts, and response owners before launch day.
anti_patterns: Do not ask directly for upvotes or coordinate artificial voting behavior.
Do not rely on generic gallery images that hide the real product.
Do not launch without someone available to reply to comments quickly.

faq.question: Does this skill publish my Product Hunt listing?
faq.answer: No. It helps plan and draft launch materials, but users publish through Product Hunt.

faq.question: Can it guarantee a top Product Hunt ranking?
faq.answer: No. Ranking depends on product quality, audience fit, engagement, timing, and Product Hunt platform behavior.

faq.question: Does it support visual asset planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends gallery order, image goals, dimensions, and example prompts for launch visuals.

faq.question: Why does the skill mention the `belt` CLI?
faq.answer: The guide includes optional `belt` examples for image generation and launch research through external apps.

faq.question: Should I verify Product Hunt requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. Product Hunt limits, topics, and interface details can change, so verify requirements before launch.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
